atoms.text:
This is superhero Raina Rainmaker and her best friend Edgar Earthworm. Raina showers the world in rain. Edgar is always by her side to help her out.

Today, Raina’s body is doing curious things. Edgar is helping her find out what they mean.

instruction.sound: Raina’s stomach is making funny growling noises. Edgar tells her she’s hungry. Choose the sound her stomach makes when she is hungry.
instruction.text:
Raina’s stomach is making funny growling noises. Edgar tells her she’s hungry.
Choose the sound her stomach makes when she is hungry.

feedback.end: If you don’t eat enough, you will feel hungry. A gurgling and growling stomach is a sign of hunger.

instruction.text: Raina decides to have a meal. Where is the food?

feedback.end: Our bodies need food to survive. It gives the body energy.

instruction.text: Roughly how much food should superheroes and children eat in one whole day? Choose the right answer.

feedback.end: Children and superheroes should eat about 3 full meals and 2 or 3 snacks a day.

instruction.text: When should Raina eat more than usual? Choose the right answer.

b.sound: When she has been exercising to gain some superhero muscles.
When she has had a relaxed day with Edgar.

feedback.end: When you exercise, your body uses up a lot of the food you ate. Then, you have to eat more than normal.
